selection: Unfitted inkWidth768, inkHeight>=720,>=6paths; non-standalone; unassigned to shared components. Source optical exemption is exactly natural_short_or_wide_form_not_full_height.
preservation_rules: No second fit for already-normalized glyphs.
No changes to registered shared-component glyphs.
No vertical stretch or fixed-aspect filling.
Keep primitives, standalone radicals and genuinely low/wide historical forms.
Do not apply candidates with new cross-path ink-contact risk.

stroke_consistency.evidence: Unchanged source manifest matches the prior all11,328 audit, whose parser asserted30-unit round wrapper for every source. Public SVG reader strictly rejects other wrappers.
stroke_consistency.note: Per-glyph pen values are already uniform. Residual apparent weight differences arise from source geometry, density, overlaps or outline/cap expansion.
